overview.text: Her priorities include property tax relief, the South Suburban Airport, mental health care, and violence prevention. She was the chief sponsor of a 2025 law regarding hospital emergency contacts. Her campaign says that as mayor, she helped facilitate a $116 million hospital expansion in Olympia Fields.
